en: A hand‑colored illustrated postcard showing a panoramic view of a large monastic complex surrounded by forested hills and a river in the foreground. The complex includes a prominent church with a tall bell tower, long cloister buildings with red-tiled roofs, and ancillary structures. The scene is labeled at the bottom in German, and there is publisher information in small print.
